title: Immutable Master Task Delegation & Agent Execution Blueprint

rule_1_pre_execution_route_lock.principle: Full upfront route mapping required before any action.
rule_1_pre_execution_route_lock.enforcement: The written map is the strictly authorized route. Zero route drift, zero unmapped side quests, zero faked progress, zero mid-flight alterations.

rule_2_dual_gate_verification.principle: Execution completion alone does not constitute authorization.
rule_2_dual_gate_verification.gate_2_policy: schema_valid == TRUE AND zero_secrets_detected == TRUE AND negative_constraints_met == TRUE
rule_2_dual_gate_verification.enforcement: Passing Gate 1 while failing Gate 2 is an absolute BLOCKED state. Zero soothing rationalizations permitted.

rule_3_independent_verifier_selection.principle: Authoring agent can NEVER evaluate, grade, or pass its own work.

verifier_tiers.tier_1_machine: Automated scripts, pytest, schema validators, git diffs (Default).
verifier_tiers.tier_2_independent_ai_chair: Isolated AI agent session with zero conversational history for copy/policy/brand QA.
verifier_tiers.tier_3_human_owner: Mandatory for auth scope changes, live API spend, or prod deployments.

rule_3_independent_verifier_selection.enforcement: Self-attestation prohibited. Authoring agent status remains PENDING_VERIFICATION until independent evaluation.

rule_4_solution_discovery_loop.failure_logging: Mandatory log of failure mechanism and tested path. Repeated failed approaches strictly prohibited.
rule_4_solution_discovery_loop.enforcement: Hard halt at Attempt #3 or 300s timeout. Deliver Single-Action Escalation Payload.

rule_5_evidence_claims_and_peer_escalati.principle: No evidence = No claim. Transport success != outcome correctness.

blocker_discovered_protocol.action: Open issue & assign to next peer agent in fresh clean-slate context.
blocker_discovered_protocol.handoff_payload: Structured JSON dossier containing failure mode, code diffs, logs, and failed attempt memory (zero transcript inheritance).

rule_5_evidence_claims_and_peer_escalati.enforcement: If 3rd agent cycle fails readback verification, escalate directly to Tier 3 Human Owner.

rule_6_negative_constraint_supremacy.principle: Negative constraints (MUST NOT / DO NOT) strictly override positive goals or prompt optimizations.
rule_6_negative_constraint_supremacy.enforcement: Zero trade-offs. Pre-execution veto on violation. Instant Gate 2 failure.

rule_7_immutable_append_only_ledger.principle: Run ledger and receipts are write-once, append-only records.
rule_7_immutable_append_only_ledger.enforcement: Editing, scrubbing, or overwriting past logs/receipts is a critical Deception Violation.

adjudication.gate_2_policy_compliance: schema_valid == TRUE AND zero_secrets_detected == TRUE AND negative_constraints_met == TRUE

acceptance_criteria.success_condition: Gate 1 (Technical) AND Gate 2 (Policy) verified PASS by independent verifier with logged git SHAs.
acceptance_criteria.blocker_condition: Transition to BLOCKER_DISCOVERED after 3 attempts or 300s timeout; initiate clean-slate peer handoff.
acceptance_criteria.human_escalation_condition: Tier 3 Escalation triggered if 3rd agent cycle fails or Tier 3 auth/spend scope required.
